items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He had a little gal called Sweet -- Sweetie-something

ctx.x: He helps everybody. The man, he -- money doesn't mean nothing to him.

He wanted a kid so bad, and -- this is real funny. He had a little gal called Sweet -- Sweetie-something and she got pregnant but not by Louie. But Louie thought it was by him because she was telling him that, you know? And, oh, he was proud. He's going to be the daddy.

So he had a bag. We were traveling by bus now, and he had a bag and all the -- when he was getting ready to go to sleep -- all the change he had in his pocket plus dollars he'd take it, put it in his bag. I asked him what he was doing that for. He said, 'That's for my kid when it's born.' Okay, so by the time this kid was born that bag was stuffed with coins and dollars and fives and tens, just stuffed.
